This came right out of their 54th National Executive Council. But mark my words, this is clearly another orchestrated play by the hidden elites and institutions running things from the shadows. The constant delays and these strike threats are being manufactured to generate chaos, undermine public universities, and advance their covert agenda, while the unions and government just follow the roles scripted for them in this whole setup.

Those endless delays and strike threats are deliberately cooked up to breed disorder, cripple public universities, and roll out their concealed agenda, with the unions and government simply acting out the parts they've been handed in the setup.
